claims.value: PlasmaCtrl: no depletion; MARS14: depletion; ProteoMiner: not applicable/not applicable; ABA, pTYR, cAMP, ATP: not applicable depletion, sample enrichment
claims.evidence: Paper 4.2 and abstract: MARS14 immunodepletion, ProteoMiner equalization, four affinity-capture probes (enrichment), undepleted plasma as comparison. Factor name is a custom label chosen by annotator; EFO:0009106 sample enrichment is the generic parent chosen since no specific child fits affinity capture
Placeholder from file suffix; paper says six replicate experiments of a plasma sample but does not state whether biological, process or technical replicates

limitations: Deposited .msf and .pdResult search files (SQLite, 1-9 GB) were not read; modifications and tolerances come from the paper and PRIDE protocol text, not from the deposited parameters

Biological replicate numbers are placeholders taken from the file-name suffix; the paper does not say whether the six replicates are independent plasma aliquots or process replicates; after review: biological replicate = 1 and technical replicate = file suffix 1-6 (assumes the paper's 'six replicate experiments' are technical replicates)
Whether the plasma is a pool of the 100 donors or one donor is not stated in the paper text read (Methods 4.1, abstract); pooled sample, age, sex, individual not annotated or not available
Acetyl and Carbamyl position given as Any N-term because the paper says only N-terminal; Protein N-term not confirmed
Precursor/fragment tolerance is Sequest HT only; MSPepSearch used 15 ppm/15 ppm
RAW headers inspected for 7 of 42 files (one per method group); the rest are assumed to share the method. Acquisition dates not annotated
ProteoMiner enrichment process set to not applicable (paper calls it equalization, no matching EFO child)
PRIDE structured fields overridden: instrument (Q Exactive HF) and quantification method (TMT) are contradicted by paper and RAW headers
characteristics[sample type] 'study sample' is flagged by the cache-only validator (known cache artifact); PRIDE:0001013 resolves live in OLS4
